title: SIG public-surface per-page data contracts (P27.1, LAUNCH.1 — FROZEN)
description: The frozen data shape each of the ten public web surfaces consumes. This is the interface P27.4 EMITS (the spine-backed export) and P27.5 RENDERS (the static web). Derived from the authoritative web/src/lib/*.ts interfaces + their *-fixture.ts exemplars + the SIG-UI /v1 dossier contract. These shapes are largely count-independent and are the stable contract the rest of the P27 chain inherits; only the row VALUES change when the spine grows (the OSM land / the P27.2 rights pass). Each surface names its source-of-truth TypeScript interface (`x_source`) so a drift check can assert the export still matches the web contract.

dossier_index.description: Surface 1 — the dossier index / national landing list. Page: /dossier + /. Producer: exports.web_dossier.build_web_dossiers → web/dossiers.json.

jurisdiction_dossier.description: Surface 2 — the per-jurisdiction dossier (§39.2, twelve sections). Page: /dossier/[slug]. Publication gate applied at build (§43.8, SIG-PUB-017).

map_layer.description: Surface 3 — the infrastructure map layer (§39.3). Producer emits GeoJSON + PMTiles (ODbL compartment SEPARATE) + the tabular MapAsset[] equivalent + JurisdictionIndicator roll-up. Coordinates reduced per sensitivity tier (§19.4/§43.3); aggregate/point only, never a per-person field.

network.description: Surface 4 — the sharing-edge network explorer (§39.4). The three §12.2 access-edge types MUST NOT be merged. Access paths carry per-hop evidence (SIG-UI-025).

data_freshness.description: Surface 5 — data-freshness per source (§32.4). Every FreshnessRow field is required (SIG-METRIC-007); staleness is measured against predicate volatility class, not absolute days.

coverage.description: Surface 6 — coverage metrics (§32.5). NEVER a population total: every metric carries a NAMED denominator (SIG-METRIC-008/009/010). is_population_total MUST be false.

watch.description: Surface 7 — the watch (§39.5). P35.43 (K7 WX-01 / F-481) emits the versioned `sig/watch/2` envelope — `sig.watch-item/1` items derived from publishable spine claims by exports/src/exports/watch.py, plus the per-place coverage block (SIG-WATCH-D04: an empty items list still carries coverage). The alert key is the DERIVED notice deadline, not the raw expiry (SIG-UI-014b/026); `contract_expiry` dates carry `date_certainty: upper_bound` and are never labelled deadlines. The web data layer projects the contract-kind items onto the legacy `ContractWatchItem[]` until the surface rows render v2 natively — the envelope is the artifact contract, the row type the render contract.

evidence.description: Surface 8 — the evidence recommender (§39.5a) + evidence viewer (§39.6). Ranking MUST NOT use persuasion/sentiment (SIG-UI-027b). Sealed captures carry metadata only, no bytes (§17.5).

corrections.description: Surface 9 — the public corrections log (§39.8) + transparency report. History is never rewritten: the prior value stays citable at its belief-time (SIG-GOV-005).

research_queue.description: Surface 10 — the research queue (§39.7). Every task has a testable closing condition (SIG-TASK-002), never 'research this'.

jurisdictionCode.description: e.g. US/FR/BE; selects the §43.8 publication adapter.

lat.description: null when no point is published (tier 3 / mobile / unknown).

precision.description: Published-precision description for the tabular equivalent.

label_basis.description: P35.29 (L-3): the closed sig.entity-label/1 basis vocabulary — source_name|source_title|key_name|slug_name|derived|fallback.

label_state.description: ADR-159 typed review state — rendered, never an improvised label.

degree.description: P35.30 (SIG-INGEST-043c): a source-stated partner COUNT — a node attribute, never an edge.

access_kind.description: The three §12.2 edge types MUST NOT be merged.

support.description: The §10.7 support level — derived from the backing claim set's declared independence classes (P35.30), never a constant.

evidence.description: The supporting claim ids (P32.15, SIG-FIND-004) — the edge names its support, never only counts it.

predicate.description: P35.30/D21: the relation words the claim predicate carries (unslugged — never a raw slot name).

observed_at.description: The earliest evidenced observation date; null when undated.

date_kind.description: undated is first-class — a 1970 placeholder renders undated, never a synthetic date (SIG-TIME-012 class honesty).

valid_from_kind.description: Valid-time START bound kind; unknown = never inferred (the single-snapshot rule).

valid_to.description: The valid-time end date when bounded.

source.description: The source DISPLAY names behind the edge, joined — never a raw source id.

sources.description: The same display names as a list.

currency.description: The §28.3 currency class derived at export (UNDATED = no evidenced date; null = unweightable — honest absence).

historical.description: True when the edge has ended or its currency is HISTORICAL — marked, out of the default current view (K2 §7 H-3).

claim_ids.description: The supporting claim ids under the D21 contract name (same set as evidence).

evidence.description: SIG-UI-025: an unexplained hop is a forbidden edge (§3.1).

is_population_total.description: MUST be false — SIG never publishes a population total (SIG-METRIC-010).

exclusions.description: ED-42/F-134: optional per-class exclusion disclosure beside a reconciliation ratio — {conflicted, withheld, non_publishable, filtered}; numerator + excluded_total = denominator, never a clamped N-of-N.

excluded_total.description: The summed exclusion count disclosed beside the numerator (ED-42).

WatchItem.description: sig.watch-item/1 (P35.43, K7 §5.1) — one derived publishable watch record. `date_certainty` is first-class: `upper_bound` MUST NOT render as a deadline. `place.key` null + `place.check: unplaced` is honest unresolved placement, never a guess.

handle.description: Deterministic W-<place>-<kind>-<slug>-<hash4> — never a retrieval timestamp or random id.

title.description: P35.31-scrubbed label; a person-named source title never surfaces verbatim (K7 §6).

date_kind.description: WHAT the date is (notice_deadline/expiry/response_deadline/meeting/status_change/scheduled_action/period_end) — never a certainty claim.

timeline.description: The subject's other dated facts (posted/signed/period bounds/prior status), attributed to their claims.

place.description: K7 §5.3 placement view — key/chain/basis/check from the P35.19 engine; key null is `unplaced`.

body.description: The deciding body (buyer/funder/tenant jurisdiction/bill jurisdiction) — claim-derived, scrubbed.

subjects.description: The connector subject keys the item derives from.

technology.description: Reviewed-vocab technology matches ({id,label}) — declared claims only.

vendor.description: Reviewed-vocab vendor matches ({id,label}) — declared claims only.

what_you_can_do.description: Procedural template text — tells a reader what they could do; never a position, never outreach (W-P4/W-P5).

evidence.description: Per-firing-claim anchors: claim/predicate/source + bound artifact ids + the S-6-gated upstream link.

termination.description: Contract kinds only — the TerminationInput wire (auto_renews/notice_window_days/expiry_date) the web's resolveTermination derives from.

tasks.description: Open research tasks on the item's subjects (e.g. contract_expiring — renewal terms unknown).

last_checked.description: The export's generated_at — the item's own check stamp.

WatchCoverage.description: SIG-WATCH-D04 — the honest coverage statement the envelope always carries: every dossier-index place row (items count may be 0), the monitored-portal statement from the committed tenant registries, per-kind counts, and the read-only sizing count (watch_subject_counts).

monitored.description: Registered tenant jurisdictions — the portals/bodies SIG actually checks.

sizing.description: Per-family {subjects, claims} counts under the same gates the producer read.

previous_belief_date.description: Belief-time at which the erroneous value still re-resolves (SIG-GOV-005).

previous_claim_id.description: P32.16a (SIG-FIND-008): the superseded/retracted claim this entry revises — the log names BOTH assertions.

revises_claim.description: The claim this entry revises (= previous_claim_id for a revision).

retraction_of.description: The claim this entry retracts (retraction outcome).

previous_withheld.description: True when the prior assertion exists but is itself gated — its value/date stay off the public surface.

task_id.description: The research_task row id — the card's unique stable identity (P34.12 / K11 RQ-00). Optional: emitted since P34.12; absent from older exports, which stay valid.

trigger.description: P29.2 — what made the detector fire (the materialized contradiction/coverage/relationship the task cites as its trigger). Optional: absent for a legacy/hand-inserted task.
